text_2ae01f96fd.message: Some cross-origin media, protected content or site restrictions may prevent processing. Peak limiting applies to each processable source; you still control the system mix and listening volume. Restricted sources may only support reducing volume, and sudden loud sounds may still pass through.

text_f0a0901bdd.message: When processing is available, high sample peaks are limited automatically. No main-panel adjustment is needed. New installations default to −1 dBFS; previously saved limits are preserved.

text_a172961212.message: This limits digital sample peaks. It does not provide true-peak or LUFS normalization, or a hearing-safety guarantee. Reconstructed waveforms and combined sources may peak higher. A saved 0 dBFS setting still retains a guard of about −0.45 dBFS in the processing chain.

text_370d721f48.message: This notice describes local audio processing and data use by this extension. Refer to the installation source for publisher contact information.

text_90b3db69a5.message: On permitted HTTP/HTTPS pages and frames, the extension detects media elements, playback and mute states. It uses page titles, tab identifiers and addresses to display and manage page audio.

text_23a011c14f.message: Where permitted, automatic mode reads a live copy of player audio. Tab capture is attempted after the user opens the extension, or by clicking the capture button, and may include all playing sounds in the selected tab. Capture requests neither microphone nor camera access; video is disabled.

text_8ca3f01c13.message: Global volume, switches and peak limits are saved in local storage on this device, without sync storage. Per-tab volume and stop states, capture errors, media frame counts and document identifiers are kept in session storage; frame addresses may be used when document identifiers are unavailable. Entries are cleared when the corresponding tab closes; browser restarts and extension reloads or updates may clear session data.

text_31564f1a47.message: Live audio samples, metrics and page titles are used for local operation and display. The extension has no audio-file recording or saving, browsing-history database or telemetry-upload feature. This statement does not cover caches, logs or network behavior of the browser, operating system or websites.

text_b39ff1a4ea.message: This extension has no developer audio server, advertising or analytics SDK, or code that actively sends the above data to the developer. It does not sell that data or use it for advertising beyond audio control. Upstream and reference links open only when clicked, and destination sites have their own policies. Bundled license files can be read offline.

text_172818b5ec.message: You can disable automatic mode, stop processing per page, or restrict site access or disable the extension in Edge. After stopping, the page controls its audio again and volume may change or increase. If audio does not recover, refresh the page and play again. Disabling automatic mode does not stop existing tab captures; use Stop tab capture or Stop all tab captures separately.

text_eb188215ed.message: Edge manages removal of extension storage on uninstall. Reinstallation or a different extension ID does not guarantee settings migration. Refer to the installation source for publisher contact information.
